headline: The Cabinet of Ministers of the Kyrgyz Republic discussed further cooperation with the ADB and the World Bank
summary: Kyrgyz Deputy Prime Minister Adylbek Kasymaliev met the World Bank's regional director for Central Asia, Naji Benhassine, and discussed continued cooperation with the bank and the Asian Development Bank.
why: The World Bank and Asian Development Bank are multilateral lenders that finance infrastructure and development projects, and their programs shape public investment and borrowing in developing economies.
original_headline: В кабмине КР обсудили дальнейшее сотрудничество с АБР и Всемирным банком
